license_required.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall only grant or renew registration to a firm engaged in the practice of attest services or public accountancy

exams.name: Registered Municipal Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Required for CPAs or PAs seeking registered municipal accountant status to audit municipal or county financial statements.
exams.quote: A certified public accountant or public accountant holding an active license shall qualify as a registered municipal accountant by passing a registered municipal accountant's examination.

interval_years.quote: The registration fee for a registered municipal accountant of New Jersey shall be established by the board, and shall be imposed for each triennial registration.

required.quote: The board shall require any person licensed as a registered municipal accountant, as a condition for triennial licensure, to complete the required number of credits of continuing professional education

period_years.quote: as a condition for triennial licensure, to complete the required number of credits of continuing professional education as determined by the board during each triennial period of licensure

available.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of a firm, in terms of financial interest and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, shall belong to certified public accountants of any state or possession of the United States or the District of Columbia in good standing

requirements.value: Out-of-state CPAs may hold ownership interests in NJ-registered firms; individuals with practice privileges from other states may perform services in NJ without registering under specified conditions.
requirements.quote: It performs those services through an individual with practice privileges under subsection d. of section 6 of P.L.2008, c.45 (C.45:2B-50.1)

title_protection.quote: Has an office in this State that uses the title "Certified Public Accountant," "CPA," "Certified Public Accountant firm," or "CPA firm"

scope_protection.quote: A firm engaged in this State in the practice of attest services and not otherwise registered with the board or exempt from registration under section 13 of P.L.1997, c.259 (C.45:2B-54) shall be required to register with the board

definition_quote.value: practice of attest services or public accountancy
definition_quote.quote: The board shall only grant or renew registration to a firm engaged in the practice of attest services or public accountancy if that firm meets the requirements provided in this section.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: There shall be a certified public accountant in the firm who has ultimate responsibility for each attest engagement.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm engaged in this State in the practice of attest services and not otherwise registered with the board or exempt from registration under section 13 of P.L.1997, c.259 (C.45:2B-54) shall be required to register with the board as a firm of public accountants.

registered_municipal_accountant_designat.quote: Only a registered municipal accountant licensed in this State shall undertake the work of auditing the financial statements of any municipality or county.

public_school_accountant_designation.quote: Any person who undertakes the work of auditing the financial statements of any school district in New Jersey shall qualify as a public school accountant (PSA)
